entities.summary: Jabril ibn Bukhtishu was an influential 8th–9th century physician from the prominent Bukhtishu (Bokhtisho') family, a dynasty of Church of the East Christian doctors associated with the Academy of Gondishapur. He spoke Syriac, though much of his medical work was composed in Arabic. Jabril ibn Bukhtishu was a physicians & medical pioneers (800 CE–828 CE).
